enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Move arm under pillow. Move leg. Remain still. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and taking a morning shower
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Swing legs over side. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply face wash. Rub face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up hand towel. Dry face. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with coffee using the kettle and toaster
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread, eggs, butter, milk. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out plate, mug, bowl. Close cupboard. Place bread in toaster. Press lever down. Plug in kettle. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add butter to pan. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Place scrambled eggs on plate. Toast pops up. Remove toast from toaster. Butter toast. Pour coffee into mug. Add milk. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat eggs. Pick up toast. Bite toast. Drink coffee. Finish meal. Pick up plate and mug. Walk to sink. Place dishes in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa, checking news and messages on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for computer to boot. Type password. Press enter. Open web browser. Type news website address. Press enter. Scroll through headlines. Click on article. Read article. Scroll down. Close article. Open messaging application. Click on conversation. Type reply. Press send. Read new messages. Type another reply. Press send. Close messaging application. Open email. Read emails. Delete spam. Close email. Close web browser. Close laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Sorting laundry and running the washing machine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open laundry hamper. Take out clothes. Sort clothes into whites and colors. Pick up whites. Walk to washing machine. Open washing machine door. Place whites into drum. Close door. Open detergent drawer. Pour detergent into compartment. Close drawer. Turn cycle selector to white wash. Press start button. Pick up colors. Wait for wash cycle to finish. Open washing machine door. Remove whites. Place whites into dryer. Close dryer door. Press start button on dryer. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming and tidying up the living room
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug cord into outlet. Turn on vacuum. Push vacuum across floor. Vacuum under coffee table. Move sofa. Vacuum under sofa. Move sofa back. Vacuum corners. Turn off vacuum. Unplug cord. Wind cord around vacuum. Put vacuum in closet. Pick up items on coffee table. Place magazines in rack. Place remote control on shelf. Fluff pillows on sofa. Fold blanket. Place blanket on sofa. Pick up trash. Throw trash in bin. Walk out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and cooking lunch at home
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, chicken, spices. Close refrigerator. Place vegetables on cutting board. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Cut chicken into pieces. Heat pan on stove. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir chicken. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add spices. Stir. Cover pan. Reduce heat. Simmer. Open cupboard. Take out plate. Close cupboard. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Walk to table. Sit down. Pick up fork. Eat lunch. Drink water. Finish meal. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Place plate in sink. Wash hands.

Sit at table. Pick up fork. Take bite of food. Chew. Swallow. Pick up glass. Drink water. Put down glass. Take another bite. Chew. Swallow. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Continue eating. Finish food. Push plate away. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Place plate in sink. Pick up glass. Place glass in sink. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting and watching TV in bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over legs. Pick up remote control. Press power button. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Stop on news channel. Watch TV. Adjust pillow. Turn to side. Watch TV. Change channel. Watch movie. Turn off TV. Put down remote. Close eyes. Rest.

enriched_activities.activity: Grocery shopping and running personal errands
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Pick up keys. Pick up wallet. Walk to door. Open door. Step out. Lock door. Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Insert key. Start engine. Drive to grocery store. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Step out. Close door. Lock car. Walk to store entrance. Pick up shopping cart. Push cart through aisles. Pick up vegetables. Place in cart. Pick up milk. Place in cart. Pick up bread. Place in cart. Push cart to checkout. Unload items onto conveyor belt. Pay cashier. Place items in bags. Put bags in cart. Push cart to car. Unload bags into trunk. Return cart. Get in car. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Drive to post office. Park car. Get out. Walk to post office. Mail package. Return to car. Drive home. Park car. Turn off engine. Get out. Lock car. Carry bags to door. Unlock door. Enter home. Close door. Put bags on kitchen counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Leisure time browsing on the computer and listening to music
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Enter password. Open music player. Select playlist. Press play. Open web browser. Type social media address. Scroll through feed. Like posts. Comment on post. Open video site. Watch video. Pause video. Open news site. Read article. Close browser. Close music player. Close laptop. Stand up. Walk out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Brisk walk and light exercise in the park
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Pick up keys. Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to park. Enter park. Start walking briskly. Swing arms. Breathe deeply. Walk around path. Pass bench. Continue walking. Stop at exercise area. Do arm stretches. Do leg stretches. Do squats. Do lunges. Do push-ups against bench. Rest. Walk back home. Unlock door. Enter home. Close door. Remove shoes.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wash face. Turn off tap. Dry face. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner using the induction cooker and oven
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out fish, vegetables, spices. Close refrigerator. Preheat oven to 200 degrees. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Season fish. Place fish on baking tray. Put tray in oven. Set timer. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add spices. Stir. Cover pan. Simmer. Check oven timer. Remove fish from oven. Place fish on plate. Turn off induction cooker. Place vegetables on plate. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat dinner. Drink water. Finish meal. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Place plate in sink.

Sit at table. Pick up fork. Cut fish. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Pick up glass. Drink water. Put down glass. Take another bite. Chew. Swallow. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Continue eating. Finish food. Push plate away. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Place plate in sink. Pick up glass. Place glass in sink. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and playing video games for evening relaxation
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote control. Press power button. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select movie. Watch TV. Pick up game controller. Press power button on console. Select game. Start game. Play game. Pause game. Watch TV. Resume game. Play game. Finish game. Turn off console. Put down controller. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Put down remote. Stand up. Walk out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, using phone and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over legs. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Scroll through social media. Open messaging app. Type message. Send message. Read reply. Type reply. Send reply. Put down phone. Pick up remote control. Press power button. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select show. Watch TV. Adjust pillow. Turn to side. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Put down remote. Pick up phone. Scroll through news. Put down phone. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Night-time hygiene routine, brushing teeth and washing
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Turn on tap. Wet toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit in sink. Turn off tap. Pick up cup. Fill with water. Rinse mouth. Spit. Put down cup. Pick up face wash. Apply to face. Rub face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to bedroom. Lie down on bed. Pick up book from nightstand. Open book to bookmark. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off bedside lamp. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Sleep.
